scope.snapshot: metadata only; exact report tag/hash/request/30-day deadline, avatar/version/generation/image hash and optional current publication/revision/pointer; no reason/bytes/GPS/URL/token

scope.decision: strict synchronous true caller authorization plus active reviewer; exact settled noncancelled report; hide requires exact still-approved published generation, revision, canonical descriptor/hash, avatar/pointer tags and active author; rejection and immutable report decision in SAME SQLite transaction
scope.recovery: read-only historical confirmed/not-applied/superseded; never replays hide or promises photo remains hidden after later actions
scope.queue: local keyset<=20 with progress marker, separate partial index/namespace, excludes cancelling and expired reports, no provider queries
scope.cleanup: inspections256/decisions100 and budgets, maintenance wake; disabled-owner erasure removes related operator/reporter/known target metadata without republishing
